copy.curiosityHook: When ordinary field life collides with laboratory science, how will a desperate mother navigate the strange world of superintelligent rats?
copy.description: To save her ailing son before a farmer's plow destroys their home, a widowed field mouse ventures beyond safety, seeking help from a friendly crow and a secretive community of escaped, superintelligent lab rats.
copy.vibeSummary: Suspenseful, emotionally grounded family adventure with a dark speculative edge; moving and steadily paced.
copy.whyWatch: Don Bluth weaves genuine dramatic stakes and sci-fi mystery into hand-drawn animation, creating an unusually atmospheric and suspenseful family adventure.

allowedMaterial: pack of superintelligent escaped lab rats
initial mission to move the home to firmer ground
excludedMaterial: villain identities or conspiracies within the rat colony
